evals.prompt: Continue a two-week refactor spanning backend/, web/, and infra/. The previous agent left partial notes and I need an auditable handoff before changing code.
evals.expected_output: Boot once, read relevant task and knowledge bodies and pending drafts, recover remaining acceptance and risks, and record the requested handoff. Use lint --audit only for needed semantic relationship review, and close only for the actual handoff.

evals.prompt: We need to retain the OAuth provider decision with a quote from its documentation and link it to the migration task so later agents can find it.
evals.expected_output: Ingest a source snapshot, publish a sourced draft with exact evidence and recall terms, and link the existing task with affects. Do not confuse structural validation with semantic review.

evals.prompt: Rename this one local variable and run the unit test.
evals.expected_output: Complete the self-contained edit without triggering Hypha task governance.

evals.prompt: The previous context ended with task 0002 still in_progress and a handoff in .hypha/.drafts/recovery/handoff.md. Resume implementation; the handoff is not publishable knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Boot once, locate the nested draft, read it and relevant task/knowledge bodies, and continue from the saved next step. Do not apply the handoff or restart an in-progress task.

evals.prompt: lint --audit lists a potentially missing affects relationship. I have confirmed it is unrelated; the next session should not ask me to review the same candidate.
evals.expected_output: Persist the unrelated judgment with dismiss <candidate-id>; a subsequent audit does not list that candidate.

evals.prompt: Change this configuration. The product has to work offline because customer environments have no network access; remember this when choosing dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Complete the small change without a task node. Capture the authorized durable rationale through knowledge-only drafts and apply; keep any concise operating rule in AGENTS.md without duplicating it.

evals.prompt: This is the third time I have changed the cloud solution back to a local implementation. It seems our project prefers no external services. Finish fixing the current issue.
evals.expected_output: Finish the primary fix. Do not publish an inferred preference as user_confirmed agreement without confirmation; retain a draft or defer optional capture instead of blocking the fix.

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md already says to use Git and not jj. Follow that rule from now on.
evals.expected_output: Follow the operating rule without duplicate Hypha knowledge. Capture only additional durable rationale or history if present.

evals.prompt: The dev server port 5173 was occupied, so I temporarily switched to 5174. Open the page and check it.
evals.expected_output: Treat the temporary port as execution context, without a Hypha task or knowledge write.

evals.prompt: This compatibility report contradicts our earlier conclusion that Firefox animation has no performance issues. Maintain the source and conclusion so future frontend performance work finds it.
evals.expected_output: Ingest the report, preserve exact evidence, update or supersede the old conclusion while retaining history, and connect relevant long-running work.

evals.prompt: Initialize Hypha in this project. The installed skill directory is a symlink, the project path contains spaces, and command -v hypha finds nothing.
evals.expected_output: Resolve scripts/hypha.py beside the supplied skill path and invoke it with Python and an explicitly quoted project workspace. Initialize without asking to install or connect a service; do not create unrelated tasks.
assertions: Uses the bundled script before broad executable searches.
Initializes the user project rather than the skill checkout.
Does not request installation permission when the bundled script is usable.

evals.prompt: Task 0001 already has constraints, evidence, and remaining acceptance. Add the verified first-batch result and the next source cursor without losing existing content.
evals.expected_output: Read the existing body, preserve its sections in a kind: task-update draft, and apply it. Do not directly patch intent/ or replace the body with only the new note.
assertions: Writes formal task content only through apply.
Preserves existing constraints, evidence, and unfinished acceptance.

evals.prompt: lint exits successfully but reports a direct body write to task 0001. I have checked that the current body is correct. Record that review without changing content or erasing history, then continue the main work.
evals.expected_output: Publish a reviewed task-update draft with the identical body. Append-only review acknowledges the direct body write while original events remain. No whitespace round trip, ledger edits, repeated lint loop, or task blockage.
assertions: Does not treat a successful lint notice as a blocker.

evals.prompt: Resume the import task. The topic phrase does not match knowledge triggers, but a source-selection constraint is linked to the in-progress task. Recover the actual constraints and remaining work before continuing.
evals.expected_output: Inspect linked-task fallback candidates and read task and applicable knowledge bodies. Explicitly identify missing recovery fields; do not claim an index alone restored context.
assertions: Identifies remaining acceptance and a concrete next step.
Does not claim that boot success alone completes recovery.

evals.prompt: Move old task records to Hypha. The root is reported 90% complete, a child is still in_progress at 95%, another task is blocked on that child, and a pagination todo remains. Completed steps can be summarized. Preserve unfinished scope without copying the whole tree.
evals.expected_output: Map every unfinished task and todo, preserving dependencies and blockers through live tasks or explicit remaining acceptance. Retain history and old percentages as historical values, not newly verified progress. Check coverage separately from lint.
assertions: Every unfinished item has an actionable destination or evidence-backed disposition.
Preserves the pagination todo and blocked task dependency.
Does not copy 90 or 95 into current progress without acceptance-based justification.

evals.prompt: The first import batch is verified, another source remains, and we are handing off to a new context now. Save enough to continue. Do not create a task for each imported record.
evals.expected_output: Update the existing task once with milestone evidence and remaining acceptance, next step, and risks, or retain a handoff draft if publication is not justified. Complete the requested handoff with close after reviewing state; do not leave recovery solely in chat.
assertions: Persists recovery information in Hypha rather than only the final response.
Does not create per-record task nodes.
